---
title: "Sample Dashboard"
format:
  dashboard:
    theme: flatly
    orientation: rows
---

## Setup

```{r}
#| include: false

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

## Scatter Plot

```{r}
#| title: MPG vs Weight

ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 3) +
  labs(
    x = "Weight (1000 lbs)",
    y = "Miles Per Gallon"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Cars by Cylinders

```{r}
#| title: Number of Cars by Cylinders

ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "darkorange") +
  labs(
    x = "Number of Cylinders",
    y = "Count of Cars"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Average MPG Table

```{r}
#| title: Average MPG by Cylinders

mtcars |>
  group_by(cyl) |>
  summarise(
    Average_MPG = round(mean(mpg), 2),
    Cars = n()
  )
```
